_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base-rate coil (±2pt moves in only 7% of recent windows) plus offset stress factors mean the honest call is hold the Hope floor until a named breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicit HOLD/Hope; narrative silent on forward phase so no direct conflict but no confirmation either
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 55–70 and funding stays near flat while BTC chops the recent range
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks under ~55 on a vol spike (down to Disbelief) or funding/momentum reheat with F&G through ~71 (up to Optimism)
